acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Peptides were analysed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer operated in data-dependent acquisition mode, coupled to an UltiMate 3000 UHPLC system.
